intro: I build useful tools, play tournament poker, and explore ideas through writing and visual storytelling.
bio_short: Nolan Kido builds useful tools, plays tournament poker, and explores ideas through writing and visual storytelling. His website brings together technology, poker, and creative work.
bio_long: Nolan Kido builds useful tools, plays tournament poker, and explores ideas through writing and visual storytelling. Technology leads his personal website, alongside a dedicated poker section and selected creative writing. His interests include practical AI, reliable software, the decisions behind poker hands, and the choices that make an explanation useful. The site is a selection of interests and public material, not a record of everything he does.
